questions.text: Walk me through how you designed a cloud architecture for a new product. What trade-offs did you record?

follow_up_suggestions.text: Which services did you choose, and what did you reject?
How did you plan for growth and for failure?

scoring_rubric.3: Explains the main components and the key trade-offs
scoring_rubric.4: Covers scaling, failure domains and cost in the design
scoring_rubric.5: Also shows how the design was reviewed, decided and written down for others

questions.text: How would you plan the migration of a large legacy system to the cloud with minimal business risk?

follow_up_suggestions.text: How would you decide which parts to move first?
How would you prove the migrated system behaves the same?

scoring_rubric.2: Proposes a lift-and-shift without assessing dependencies
scoring_rubric.3: Sequences workloads by dependency and risk with a fallback plan
scoring_rubric.4: Uses phased cut-overs, parallel running and clear success criteria
scoring_rubric.5: Also plans for skills, change management and benefits tracking

questions.text: How do you keep cloud costs under control as several teams deploy independently?

follow_up_suggestions.text: What tools or reports do teams use to see their own spending?
How do you balance cost against reliability decisions?

scoring_rubric.2: Reacts to bills after they arrive
scoring_rubric.3: Uses tagging, budgets and regular reviews
scoring_rubric.4: Gives teams cost ownership and reviews design choices for cost
scoring_rubric.5: Also links unit costs to business metrics and plans capacity ahead of demand

questions.text: How do you design network segmentation and access between environments, such as production and development?

follow_up_suggestions.text: How would you stop development traffic reaching production data?
How do you give engineers access when they need to debug production?

scoring_rubric.2: Uses one flat network for everything
scoring_rubric.3: Separates environments with controlled routes and access
scoring_rubric.4: Uses least-privilege access and audited break-glass procedures
scoring_rubric.5: Also automates network policy and tests it continuously

questions.text: Describe how you would guide a team that wants to adopt a new cloud service the organisation has not used before.

follow_up_suggestions.text: What would you check before the team starts building?
How do you stop the new service becoming a one-team exception?

scoring_rubric.3: Reviews security, cost and support needs before adoption
scoring_rubric.4: Provides a reference pattern and a review path other teams can reuse
scoring_rubric.5: Also builds a decision record, training and an ongoing owner for the service
